_comment: Approved reviews appear on the homepage in the Testimonials section. Newest first (top of array = top of page). The three letter excerpts are real quotes from the recommendation letters published in full at /recommendations — do not edit their wording. When you receive a submission email and want to publish it, add a new object to the START of the `reviews` array, copy the fields from the email, and push.

_schema.name: Full name with optional title/suffix, e.g. 'Dr. Jane Smith, PhD'
_schema.title: Job title, e.g. 'Senior Battery Engineer'
_schema.connection: How they know Rudy (short phrase, ALL CAPS look applied via CSS)
